name: central-system
description: A NodeJS backend for the token issuer within ALICE O2

scripts.docker:build: cd ../.. && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.yml build
scripts.docker:up: cd ../.. && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.yml up
scripts.docker:up:build: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
scripts.docker:down: cd ../.. && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.yml down
scripts.docker:test:integration: cd ../.. && docker compose --profile test -p tokenization-tests -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --abort-on-container-exit central-tests && docker compose --profile test -p tokenization-tests -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration:docker
